posts.author: dj-Nate
posts.title: About Me
posts.html:
Hello everyone, I'm dj-Nate. Thanks to the generosity of Tom Morris, this new board was created for me. If you like any type of trance/techno/dance music, check out some of my stuff. I'll sticky a download thread with all of my top tracks for anyone to download for free. And feel free to post my music in different threads if you'd like as well.

As a side note, I'm going to be a very laid back, easy-to-work-with moderator. As long as you don't spam or break any copyrights (or laws obviously), you're pretty set to post what you wish.

And I absolutely LOVE Counterstrike Source. PM me if you wanna play.

Thanks for your time,
Nate

posts.author: dj-Nate
posts.title: Re: About Me
posts.html:
Thanks for the positive feedback guys.

I'm also thinking about a request thread. I'll make a song for anyone who requests it, and post it publicly. I'll give more details later, but I'll list a bunch of genres I can do, and anyone can go ahead and post what genre they want me to make, and I'll add it to my request list. That would be fun for me, and hopefully you. How badass would it be to get a headshot off while a song made for YOU is playing? Haha, this is just an idea. Let me know.
